test_title: PYST 27: SSC CGL 2025 Tier-I Similar Paper - English (Held On: 20th Sep 2025 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
Choose the most suitable option to replace the highlighted part:

He entered the temple **bare footed**.
solution:
The correct answer is '1' i.e. barefoot .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **barefoot** is the correct term to describe someone not wearing shoes.
 
• The term **barefooted** is also grammatically correct but less commonly used in modern English.
 
• Using **with bare feet** is unnecessarily wordy and awkward in this context.
 
• The option **bear foot** is incorrect as it refers to the foot of a bear and is irrelevant in this context.

Correct sentence: *He entered the temple **barefoot**.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Usage of Barefoot:**
 
 
• The term **barefoot** is commonly used as both an adjective and an adverb.
 
• **Example:** She walked barefoot on the beach.
 
 
 
• **Alternative Usage:** While **barefooted** is also correct, it is more formal and less commonly preferred in contemporary English.
